name: Site Settings and Labels Type Permissions
description: Allows users to configure permissions for individual Site Settings types.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Site Settings and Labels 
 This module provides a way to let clients manage settings you define without affecting the configuration of the site (ie, as 'Content'). It does the following:

 
 provides an interface for administrators to set up settings 
 allows administrators to add one or more fields to each setting 
 allows the administator to decide whether to allow multiple occurrences of the same setting 
 allows the administrator to group settings together 
 provides a simple interface for anyone with the new permissions to add, edit, and delete site settings content 
 caches the data and efficiently makes it available in every twig template 
 stores the configuration for each setting as config so site builders can version control the available settings and their fields while keeping the content added to each setting outside of version control 
 makes the settings available as tokens for use anywhere tokens are used (note that tokens are only supported at this time for non-repeating site settings that contain a single field) 
 allows quick mass replication of settings and labels 
 provides a simple block to output site settings, further customisable in templates as described below 
 
 Back to top 

 Example use cases 
 
 You want to let a client add one or more social networks with links to their profile pages and you want to show that on a few templates such as the header and footer 
 You want to let a client add some general settings to control how or where things are displayed 
 You want to allow a client to specify some general labels or settings you use throughout your site 
 Anything else not suitable as a full content type, taxonomy term, block content, etc 
 You want to let a client add some general settings that they can reuse as tokens in for instance automated emails (see note above) 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 To install this module, place it in your modules folder and enable it on the

modules page.

 Back to top 

 How to set up your settings 
 
 Set up your settings and add fields to your settings 
 Manage the Teaser to control the display in the Admin > Content > Site Settings list 
 Manage the default Display Mode to control the display in your theme 
 Use the twig functions to render the Site Settings in your theme 
 Export your settings config 
 Deploy your work to your production site 
 Choose your desired permissions in the admin > people > permissions tab to grant access to site editors for instance 
 
 Back to top 

 How to access the settings in twig templates 
 
 (Recommended) Full Site Settings Loader using Twig Functions 
 Throughout Admin > Structure > Manage Site Settings, there are help texts with code snippets you can copy paste. That is the simplest method. The full set of available Twig functions are listed below.

 The Full Site Settings Loader is a simple wrapper around Entity Type Manager Storage. Rendering Site Settings into your templates is now primarily via Twig functions. 

 Twig function site_setting_field() 
 {{ site_setting_field('my_machine_name', 'field_fieldname') }} to render the field 'field_fieldname' from Site Setting type 'my_machine_name' in the full view mode.

 Twig function site_setting() 
 {{ site_setting(6) }} to render Site Setting ID 6 in default display mode.

 Twig function site_settings_by_name() 
 {{ site_settings_by_name('my_machine_name') }} to render one or more entities by site setting machine name (type) in default display mode.

 Twig function all_site_settings() 
 

{% set all_site_settings = all_site_settings() %}

{{ all_site_settings }}

 

to render all Site Settings in default display mode.

 Twig function site_settings_by_group() 
 

{% set site_settings = site_settings_by_group('My Group') %}

{{ site_settings }}

 

to render all Site Settings within a specified group in default display mode.
